n.bookSourceComment:
设置变量修改发音人（源变量全局，书籍变量某本书）
0 - 真人发音（非每本书都支持）
1 - 甜美少女音（默认）
2 - 清亮青叔音
4 - 成熟大叔音
5 - 开朗青年音
6 - 温柔淑女音
12 - 清纯少女音
17 - 磁性青叔音
（不全，欢迎补充）

ruleBookInfo.name: book_name
ruleBookInfo.author: author

ruleContent.content:
<js>
item_id = java.hexDecodeToString(result);
java.log(source.getVariable())
tone_id = book.getVariable("custom").trim() != "" ? book.getVariable("custom").trim() : (source.getVariable().trim() != "" ? source.getVariable().trim() : "1")
info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(java.log("https://reading.snssdk.com/reading/reader/audio/playinfo/?tone_id=" + tone_id + "&item_ids=" + item_id + "&pv_player=-1&aid=1967")))
info.data[0].backup_url
</js>

ruleSearch.name: book_name||title##\s*<\/?em>\s*
ruleSearch.author: author
ruleSearch.kind:
男生{{$.gender}}女生
{{$.category}}
连载{{$.creation_status}}完结
{{$.score}}分
##连载0|1完结
@js:result
.replace(/男生.女生/, String(java.getString("$.isbn")) ? "出版" : `男生${java.getString("$.gender")}女生`)
.replace("男生0", "")
.replace("1女生", "")
.replace("男生2女生", "出版")
.replace("连载4完结","断更")
.replace("连载-1完结","未知");
